body:
## MiniMax-H3 progress <-> Issue/PR mapping (updated 2026-08-25)

Legend: :white_check_mark: merged/done - :hourglass_flowing_sand: open/in-progress PR - :warning: partial/limited - :x: TODO (no issue/PR yet)

### 1 Feature completeness

#### 1.1 API alignment
| Status | Ref | Note |
|---|---|---|
| :warning: | #5751 (issue) + #5752 + #6391 (issue) + #6497 | The official FL2VA/Ref2VA input matrix is merged; follow-ups track an Ascend first/last-frame control regression and restore aspect-preserving letterbox preprocessing for reference images |
| :white_check_mark: | #5720 | Modular pipeline: FL2VA/Ref2VA share text_encoder/vae; startup task selection via `--task-type` |
| :hourglass_flowing_sand: | #5756 + #5905 | ComfyUI r2v frontend support is merged; follow-up exposes `generate_sound` and preserves generated audio when converting MP4 responses to ComfyUI `VIDEO` objects |

#### 1.2 Feature completeness and compatibility

| :white_check_mark: | #5785 | ComfyUI integration hint added to MiniMax-H3 recipe |
| :white_check_mark: | #5824 | Fail H3 encoder load when a weight or fused shard is missing (#5691 review follow-up) |

| :warning: | #5724 + #6345 | The low-tile-count VAE hang fix is merged and falls back to rank-local tiling when decoder tiles are fewer than ranks; the broader small-canvas tiling change remains open |

| :warning: | #2783 + #6476 + #6550 + #6473 | LightX2V MiniMax-H3 Turbo v1.0 is merged through the legacy dynamic LoRA manager for FL2VA/T2VA. The merged path remains single-adapter and request-path based; DLO-compatible resident LoRA sidecars are in review across no-AllGather and AllGather topologies, while a model-declared startup-registered runtime remains the long-term draft direction |
| :hourglass_flowing_sand: | #6540 | A two-stage H3 Super Acceleration draft combines four-step H3 Turbo/TAEH3 generation with a three-step LTX-2.5 refiner. Two-B300 dense-attention measurements report 5-second median E2E 8.777 s and 10-second median 19.154 s; Sol-Attention and perceptual/reference parity are not yet claimed |
| :warning: | #6139 (issue) | Convrot pruned-INT8 checkpoint loading requested; no implementation PR yet |

| :hourglass_flowing_sand: | #6584 (issue) + #6585 | A WIP fix makes diffusion INT8 row scales TP-invariant across the correct process group, covers H3's independent text-encoder TP group, and enables existing ROCm INT8 kernels. Current evidence is execution/weight-contract smoke, not BF16-vs-INT8 quality parity |
| :white_check_mark: | #5978 | Model-card T2VA/I2VA/Ref2VA accuracy gates merged after validation on 4xB300 |
| :hourglass_flowing_sand: | #5848 | ModelOpt mixed FP8 support for MiniMax-H3 |

Four-GPU FL2VA/Ref2VA runs report exact decoded-output parity and 20.6%-31.7% faster warm startup; cold startup is near baseline and TP/HSDP/other online quantizers remain out of scope |
| :hourglass_flowing_sand: | #6162 + #6493 (RFC) | Staged SVDQuant work starts with rank-32 NVFP4 W4A4 DiT loading; low-memory checkpoints, sub-32-GB deployment, Ref2VA coverage, and native optimized kernels remain later phases |

| :hourglass_flowing_sand: | #5922 | Pin encoder offload buffers for faster CPU<->GPU transfer |
| :hourglass_flowing_sand: | #5911 | Independent heterogeneous requests for rank-local DLO DP, with replica-local request/KV collectives and explicit idle assignments |
| :hourglass_flowing_sand: | #5955 | Bounded, pipelined host staging for DLO to reduce persistent pinned payload; currently scoped to rank-local `--dlo-no-use-allgather` mode |

| :warning: | #6198 | Earlier rank-local mmap draft closed unmerged; its design was superseded by loader-owned Phase A in #6213 |
| :warning: | #6195 + #6231 + #6240 | The private node-local host-cache/direct-H2D prototype closed unmerged after its cache contract was replaced by the shared Host Weight Runtime series. Its L20X near-parity inference and lower-TP2-PSS evidence informed the replacement |
| :white_check_mark: | #6419 + #6427 + #6445 | Host Weight Runtime foundation, explicit warm-future post-load publication, and MiniMax-H3 BF16 final-layout artifact production/restoration are merged. These contracts do not activate DLO consumption by themselves |
| :warning: | #6486 + #6501 + #6591 | BF16 Host Weight Runtime consumption is merged for no-AllGather DLO with bounded staging and exact warm-hit restoration. The per-tensor FP8 AllGather producer remains draft; direct registered-mmap H2D is also in review and removes most CPU copy work but has not shown a repeatable request-latency gain |
| :hourglass_flowing_sand: | #6526 + #6530 | H3 DLO component-lifecycle reuse and per-component offload policy remain draft. L20X measurements report 14.1% lower request latency for lifecycle reuse (+1.9 GB HBM); keeping the full text encoder resident saves another 6.8% while adding 47.3 GB peak HBM |
| :hourglass_flowing_sand: | #6374 | Chunked H2D/AllGather transport overlap is in review; current end-to-end evidence is on Cosmos3/NPU, so MiniMax-H3 accuracy/performance qualification remains pending |
| :white_check_mark: | #6073 | DLO/layerwise hook dispatch now stays outside regional `torch.compile` graphs, fixing the compile-time worker-crash path |
| :warning: | - | Current main (pre-#5929): single-GPU layerwise keeps H3 Qwen3-VL encoder as whole-model load/offload (`_encode_text_hidden`), not blockwise |
| :white_check_mark: | #6279 | DLO AllGather now supports finalized per-tensor online-FP8 weights/scales with physical-layout reconstruction. TP, component-selective AllGather, HSDP, and other online quantization methods remain outside this completed scope |

The fast path is limited to validated single-batch `[real, pad]` packing, not arbitrary masks |

### 4 Production

#### 4.1 Diffusion Continuous batching
| Status | Ref | Note |
|---|---|---|
| :white_check_mark: | #5810 | H3 step execution and continuous batching are merged. FLASH_ATTN can pack multiple requests into one document-aware DiT forward; other backends fall back to per-request forwards. DLO and `num_outputs_per_prompt > 1` remain unsupported in step mode, and batching is scheduler control rather than a claimed speedup |
| :white_check_mark: | #6023 | Generic request-level batching output/IPC fixes merged (including large split-tensor shared-memory handling); this is a runtime prerequisite, not evidence that H3 step continuous batching is complete |

#### 4.2 Request interruption / abort
| Status | Ref | Note |
|---|---|---|
| :warning: | #5810 + #6403 (issue) | Step-boundary abort is merged through H3 step execution, but the async video API still marks queued work in-progress too early and deleting a running task does not yet wire through to stop accelerator execution |
| :warning: | #5983 + #6255 + #6253 (fixes #5793 / #5821) | Cancelled-future delivery handling and a higher configurable async-output wait bound are merged; guarding every result-pump dispatch, exposing pump death through health checks, and dropping abandoned decoded outputs remain in review |
| :white_check_mark: | #6385 | Diffusion execution failures now release retained accelerator memory, improving recovery after failed H3 requests |

#### 4.3 Large video output transport

|---|---|---|

| :hourglass_flowing_sand: | #6499 + #6579 | Parallel planar conversion remains in review; a separate frontend change moves non-streaming MP4 encoding off the asyncio event loop. The latter reduces measured heartbeat gaps by 99.8% with byte-identical output, without claiming encode or E2E acceleration |
| :hourglass_flowing_sand: | #6212 (RFC) + #6477 + #6541 (RFC) | Device-side uint8 reduction and configurable URL/shared-memory/video-codec transport remain in review. The follow-up proposes a stable runtime-owned video-media contract before D2H; direct streaming and broader colocated zero-copy production validation remain open |
